sources.observation: add_file builds a relative source from sandbox.root + relative_header_path to the namespaced header directory, then uses FileUtils.ln_sf on POSIX; the link basename equals the source basename.
create_module_map and create_umbrella_header link the generated support file to the target header directory using a canonical relative source.
create_module_map also links custom generated module maps to the target header namespace.
Initializes the Private HeadersStore; describes public/private file mappings and computes module_map_path under the header namespace.

additionalObservation: Initializes the Public HeadersStore and defines headers_root as sandbox.root/Headers.
localPinnedReactNativeEvidence: scripts/ci/validate-locks.rb already permits build/generated/ios local sources
node_modules/react-native/scripts/codegen/templates/ReactCodegen.podspec.template describes source files generated under that codegen path
policyLimitation: Source evidence establishes tool behavior, not the actual CI dependency layout. Only file aliases in Pods/Headers/{Public,Private} with approved header/modulemap suffixes, canonical relative targets and identical source basename are eligible. Physical targets must be single-link regular files without linked ancestors under Pods, npm, or ios/build/generated/ios, and all target bytes are hashed. Other links fail closed.
